_note: Single source for the Download page. Only set status to 'available' after a real signed release exists in the releases repo, then fill version, released, url and sha256 for each file from that release's SHA256SUMS. Never point url at a preview or placeholder file.

downloads.label: Installer package
downloads.summary: Contains install.sh, the setup wizard, signed checksums and the list of signed SentinelCore images. Extract it on Ubuntu, run sudo ./install.sh, and the wizard installs the full application.

downloads.label: One-line installer
downloads.summary: Verifies a signature and checksum, installs the package, then starts the setup wizard. Needs Ubuntu or Debian and internet access.

downloads.label: Debian package (.deb)
downloads.summary: Installs the files and the sentinelcore command. Then run sudo sentinelcore install to start the wizard.

downloads.label: Offline bundle
downloads.summary: For machines without internet: container images, installer and signed checksums in one archive.
